key_insights: Two-stage architecture can be DEPRECATED - single-stage R2 >= 0.9998
Classifier is trivially easy - bldg_gap_clip alone achieves 96.8% accuracy
Model needs only 4 features: road_gap_clip, area_gap_clip, poi_gap_clip, pct_urban
pct_urban is the critical 4th feature that unlocks full performance

performance.note: Single-stage direct regression on full target (incl. zeros)

fairness.recommendation: Use tribal interactions + 3x reweighting for best fairness

feature_importance.shap_dominance: These 4 features account for >99% of model performance
feature_importance.3_feat_insufficient: R2=0.23 without pct_urban - pct_urban is critical for zero-separation

limitations: Tribal tracts have 2x higher MAE even with reweighting
Spatial CV shows minimal overfitting on this target (R2≈1.0 because proxy is deterministic)
recommendations: DEPRECATE two-stage architecture - use single-stage direct regression
Apply tribal reweighting (3x) + tribal interaction features
Monitor top 4 feature distributions for drift in production
Flag predictions with ensemble disagreement > p90 for human review
